Question 1
?

In terms of rigid motions, why are the polygons P and Q congruent?

a
Q is the image of P under translation by 5 units to the right and 5 units down
b
 Q is the image of P under reflection in the x-axis
c
Q is the image of P under translation by 5 units to the right and 3 units up
d
The polygons are not congruent
e
Q is the image of P under rotation by 180∘ around the origin
